description: Use this when someone asks what a second-hand item sells or resells for on Vinted, what it's worth used, or the most to pay for one to resell at a profit (e.g. 'how much does a used PS5 Slim sell for on Vinted?'). Works best for electronics, consoles, phones, laptops and branded items named by model. Do not use for new retail prices, for judging one specific listing link (use check_listing_deal), or for what to list one's own item at (use suggest_listing_price).

product.description: The item, as specific as the person said it: brand, model, storage or size, e.g. 'iPhone 13 128GB', 'PS5 Slim Digital', 'Nintendo Switch OLED'.
product.title: Product

site.description: The Vinted site the person uses, as its country code: fr, de, it, es, nl, be, pl, pt, at, lt, cz, sk, hu, ro, se, dk, fi, ie, uk, us. Sets the currency. Use the person's country when they don't say; leave empty when unknown.
site.title: Site
